narrative.overview: Icon Desk Drawer treats launching software as pressing a compact bank of physical keys. Native Windows icons remain the visual content.
keyCharacteristics: Recessed square launch keys with short mechanical travel.
One cool-blue signal reserved for readiness and focus.
Equal spacing and symmetric outer margins.
Native Windows icon artwork without decorative wrappers.

rules.name: Signal Discipline
rules.body: Blue communicates a live state; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: Mechanical Feedback
rules.body: Every launch visibly changes both position and shadow before the target opens.

dos: Do keep insertion lanes visibly discoverable without overpowering native icons.
Do keep launch feedback physical, brief, and tied to the opening action.
Do let native application icons carry visual identity.
donts: Don't add widgets, skins, ornamental glow, or plugin-style chrome.
Don't use the blue signal on inactive decoration.
Don't change key dimensions between horizontal and vertical modes.
